full_judgment: 5. At the time of trial the prosecution examined 5 witnesses in support of the charge and they were cross-examined by the accused-petitioners. The defence case as suggested to the complainant PW 1 Bhupal Chandra Chowdhury is that apart from the fact that the accused-petitioner Sudhir Das Gupta is the Chairman, the accused Ananta and Sadhan are elected members and accused Sayedul Huq is a nominated member and Abdul Monnaf is a Chowkidar of the local Pahartali Union Parishad. PW 1 admitted the same but in the petition of complaint they were described as lathials. It was also admitted that Court Sankar Bazar had been leased out to the Chairman for 9 years with effect from 1386 BS. It was the further case of the defence that on the date of occurrence the complt. attempted to erect a house in the khas land and the petitioner No. 1 informed the police about the same and the Police went to the place of occurrence and due to such reason the present false case has been started. This suggestion however was denied by PW 1.
